name: setState
summary: Flutter's built-in State API for widget-local ephemeral state.
advantages: Built into Flutter with no package dependency
tradeoffs: Does not provide an application-wide state architecture
Shared or asynchronous state can become difficult to organize if handled only with setState
recommendedFor: Small widgets whose state does not need to be shared across distant parts of the app

verification.reason: Flutter official state-management guidance explicitly positions setState as a low-level option for widget-specific ephemeral state.
